name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may also be
submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 5:00 p.m. on the day before
the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  A.J. PADELFORD PARK
  11870 169TH STREET, BUILDING B
  ARTESIA, CA 90701

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  SATURDAY, JUNE 24, 2023
  9:00 A.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and submit
it to the City Clerk prior to the commencement of the meeting. Under California law, public
comments at special meetings. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is
prohibited from taking action on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the
matter to staff or to a subsequent meeting.

COUNCILMEMBER RETREAT DISCUSSION ITEMS
DISCUSSION AMONG COUNCILMEMBERS REGARDING STRATEGIC PLANNING
AND PRIORITY TOPICS, INCLUDING, BUT NOT LIMITED TO:
  • CITY FINANCES
  • DEPARTMENT OPERATIONS
  • RESIDENT SERVICES
  • ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT
  • VISION FOR CITY
HANDOUTS

CITY MANAGER INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for Councilmembers to provide general comments, announcements, and
requests of staff and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers.

ADJOURNMENT
The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
